# Calibre Associates

> Calibre Associates is a digital marketing agency serving businesses in India and the United States. It builds websites, runs SEO and local SEO, manages social media and paid advertising, edits video, and sets up AI automation and CRM systems. It was founded in December 2025 in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, and has a North America presence in Buffalo, New York.

## Quick facts

- Business type: digital marketing agency (websites, SEO, social media marketing, lead generation, paid ads, AI automation, CRM, brand identity, video editing)
- Founder and CEO: Abhijeet Jain, who is also Managing Director of 716 Lawn Care in Buffalo, New York
- Co Founder and Talent Manager: Manasvi Pathak (Agra, India)
- Markets: India and the United States, with most portfolio work for local service businesses around Buffalo, Rochester and Syracuse, New York
- Booking: https://calendly.com/calibreassociates/meeting
- Email: info@calibreassociates.com
- Phone India: +91 9792848868. Phone USA (Buffalo, NY): +1 716 355 1231

## Services

- [Website Development](https://calibreassociates.com/services/website-development/): Custom WordPress and React websites for small businesses, built for speed, search visibility and lead conversion.
- [SEO](https://calibreassociates.com/services/seo/): Local SEO, technical SEO and content for rankings in Google and AI search.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://calibreassociates.com/services/social-media-marketing/): Content creation, UGC production and social media management.
- [Video Editing](https://calibreassociates.com/services/video-editing/): Reels, YouTube and ad video editing.
- [Lead Generation and Paid Advertising](https://calibreassociates.com/services/lead-generation-paid-advertising/): Google Ads, Meta Ads and CRM automation that bring in qualified leads.
- [AI Automation and Solutions](https://calibreassociates.com/services/ai-automation-solutions/): AI automation and CRM workflows built on HighLevel and n8n.
- [Brand Identity Development](https://calibreassociates.com/services/brand-identity-development/): Brand identity systems, packaging and campaign creative.
- [Application and Software Development](https://calibreassociates.com/services/application-software-development/): Custom web applications and business software.
- [All Services](https://calibreassociates.com/services/): Overview of every service.
